card.summary: The Weather Research and Forecasting Innovation Reauthorization Act of 2026 aims to improve weather research, forecasting, and prediction capabilities at the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA). It reauthorizes and updates various programs related to severe weather, hurricanes, tsunamis, drought, and fire weather, while also expanding commercial weather data opportunities and artificial intelligence integration.
